title: Assess hail damage to crop fields with SAVI change
output_type: vector/table (mean vegetation loss per field) + map
required_outputs: any result file (instruction names none); reference writes field_vegetation_loss.geojson, field_vegetation_loss.csv, hail_damage_fields.png
method: Fields: shapefile lacking .shx/.dbf/.prj - restore .shx in a writable copy, coordinates are Web Mercator (EPSG:3857), row order = Field_ID; reproject to UTM 12N. SAVI = (NIR-Red)/(NIR+Red+0.5)*1.5 on reflectance (DN/10000; red = band 3, NIR = band 4, nodata 0) for both images on their overlap (same 3 m lattice); loss = SAVI_before - SAVI_after; negative loss -> NoData (authors' remap); mean per field (287 of 319 fields in the overlap); join and map.
benchmark_defects: Field_boundaries.shp is supplied without .shx/.dbf/.prj: no Field_ID attribute and no CRS; the coordinates are Web Mercator although the imagery is UTM 12N. Reading needs SHAPE_RESTORE_SHX in a writable copy (dataset is read-only).
Dataset description names Field_Boundaries.shp/Before_Storm.tif with different capitalisation and a 'Field_ID, Shape_Area' schema that is not present.
Before/After images have different extents; only 287 of 319 fields are covered by both.
checks: required: at least one result file in pred_results

required: per-field loss result (captured table, dict/Series keyed by field id, or CSV/vector file; aligned by geometry in UTM or Web Mercator, id column with 0- or 1-based ids, or full row index) covers >= 80 % of gold fields
required: per-field ranking Spearman >= 0.85 with gold
required (the text names SAVI): SAVI L = 0.5 used (code inspection)
